doc.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

title: Florida concert and Marian McPartland's 80th birthday broadcast
summary: Recent concert in Florida, the sudden call to fill in for Joe Williams, and singing Marian's song with her.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s coming up in the near future for you?
We just got back from Florida, we did a concert down there for the Gold Coast Jazz Society, and we didn’t know what to expect because we haven’t been performing in Florida, and it just happened.
I think we only did one job down there, at a club called Bubba’s.
At any rate, we went down and we rehearsed with Don Payne the bass player who we met in Riverdale.
Our friend’s house we used.
And then a guy who’s been with us recording and on tour, Steve Bagley the drummer. And so it was alumni. We rehearsed them and did the concert and it turned out to be wonderful, it was just perfect.
It was in a beautiful little theater, just the right size.

Gorgeous Steinway piano. It played itself, all I had to do was sit there and look. And we did that and then we hung out in Naples, Florida with some of our friends for about five days vacationing. Came home. Opened up the suitcases, emptied them, put them away, and all of a sudden we get a call from John Schriber, he said, “I know it’s kind of sudden, but could you guys appear on Marian McPartland’s 80th birthday on Saturday?” This was Thursday.
Thursday night.

And we said, yeah, sure, why not? We’re here. Okay. And he says, “oh thank you, you saved our lives, because Joe Williams got sick and he’s not going to be able to make it.” So that was it. And then Jackie said why not, for Marian’s 80th birthday, let’s sing that song of hers that she wrote with Peggy Lee. What’s it called?
“In the Days of Our Love,” which is pretty.
So I went looking through music and then I just had to go back 15 years or whatever, two years ago we did it I think.
Well we did it a couple of years ago, once.
To find it, to see what key or what the melody is or what the lyrics are. And so Friday Jackie’s going back and learning this song, that she’s going to do Saturday, with Marian.

Yeah. And I’m not used to working with other pianists very often, because I don’t get to do it that much. You know I’ve done it a few times but not often. And so we ran through it once in the theater, you know, when we came in for the sound check. And her chords sounded so totally different. And it was an odd piece.
Only in a few places. Oh God, she played some beautiful things.
Oh she played beautiful things, yeah. But it did sound different to me, and I don’t know, it was another key for her too, because she didn’t write it in that key. But she’s amazing.
She’s brilliant.
She is brilliant that way. She can do any key.
Bamm just like that she got it.

I mean she’s just great. So we did it last night, and I was like a little nervous on it, and I kind of clenched up there a couple of times. But I got through it, and after I came back to the release after she played a half a chorus, then I got it better, because I had been through it once and, oh yeah, now I remember what it is. That was through though and being a broadcast, you know, a live broadcast, made me feel pressured about it. I probably wouldn’t have been nervous but I was nervous because of that.
